title: Ben's Moon Hat Department
synopsis: Ben opens a make-believe hat shop for the Moon, a basket, and a pencil; later he observes that the waxing crescent looks broader than Amy described several nights before.
continuity_state: Before: Amy saw a thin silver waxing crescent from Blue Door Cottage in 031000. The Book of Little Sounds, brown Button Town envelope, and garden folder remain on Story House shelf. After: Several evenings after 031000, Ben and Amy make paper pretend Moon hats at Story House with Grandma. Hat scraps, the paper Moon circle and a tiny spoon-hat go home in Ben's bag. One tiny paper hat hangs at his bedpost. The real Moon is a wider waxing crescent that night. Story House collections unchanged; orange lantern tilted at window.

related_resources.reason: The AAP clinical report synthesizes evidence on active pretend play; it does not specifically examine narrated fiction or paper hats for a Moon.
NASA describes how the visible sunlit portion of the Moon increases over the waxing part of its phase cycle, given the several intervening evenings.
